name: chad
description: C.H.A.D. shows your iPhone what each Codex session is doing and notifies you when it finishes or needs your input.

interface.longDescription: C.H.A.D. shows your iPhone what each Codex session is doing, and sends a push notification when a task finishes or stops to wait for your answer. Requires the C.H.A.D. iPhone app; sign in with the same Apple ID.
defaultPrompt: Work on this task and notify my phone when you finish or need my input
